narrator.performance_direction: Mature, warm, low-to-mid masculine English narration; calm, compassionate, historically grounded, with controlled firmness in the final act.
narrator.consistency_rule: Use this voice for all narrator lines in every part.

mascot.performance_direction: Lighter, warm, alert and gently wry.

authority_warriors.performance_direction: Grounded adult masculine, textured and controlled.

strategists_younger_men.performance_direction: Clear, thoughtful adult masculine, slightly lighter and more agile than authority warriors.

women_divine_prophetic.performance_direction: Clear adult feminine, poised and emotionally precise; never exaggerated.

master_brief_voice_limit: Narrator plus up to three extra character voices and one distinct mascot voice.
